title: 认知偏差与决策
text:
“人类并非完全理性的生物，而是在潜意识引导下进行选择的个体。”这句话揭示了认知心理学中的核心命题。个体在处理复杂信息时，往往依赖启发式路径而非严密的逻辑推演。这种心理机制旨在提高反应速度，却不可避免地导致系统性偏差。
确认偏差是其中最具代表性的现象。人们倾向于搜集支持既有观点的证据，同时忽略与之相悖的客观事实。这种选择性感知强化了原有的成见，使得个体陷入认知闭环。
锚定效应则影响了价值评估的精准度。当最初接收到的数值成为参照点，后续的判断将围绕该基准展开。即便该数值缺乏合理依据，其影响力依然显著。
损失厌恶揭示了人类对负面结果的过度敏感。失去一项既有权益所带来的痛苦，远超获得同等价值收益时的快感。这种不对称性常导致决策者采取过度保守的策略。
框架效应证明了信息呈现方式能左右最终抉择。相同的客观事实，若通过不同语境表述，会诱导截然相反的结论。
这些心理陷阱在金融市场与公共管理领域尤为突出。过度自信会导致投资者低估潜在风险，进而引发非理性繁荣。
克服此类缺陷需要建立审慎的反思机制。通过引入第三方审计或采用结构化分析法，可以有效抵消主观偏见。
认知科学的研究表明，意识到偏差的存在是实现理性决策的首要前提。只有通过持续的元认知训练，个体才能在复杂环境下做出更客观的判断。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is confirmation bias?
options: The tendency to seek evidence supporting existing views while ignoring contradicting facts
The tendency to always doubt one's own opinions
A preference for random, unbiased sampling
The inability to remember any past decisions

questions.prompt: What is the anchoring effect, as described in the text?
options: Later judgments revolve around an initial number received, even if it lacks a rational basis
The tendency to always average multiple estimates together
A bias that only affects professional statisticians
The complete rejection of any numerical reference point

questions.prompt: How does loss aversion affect decision-makers' strategies, according to the text?
options: It often leads them to adopt overly conservative strategies
It makes them take on excessive risk to avoid losses
It has no measurable effect on strategy
It only applies to gambling, not business or policy decisions

questions.prompt: What does overconfidence lead investors to do, according to the text?
options: Underestimate potential risk, which can trigger irrational exuberance
Always sell their assets too early
Avoid the stock market entirely
Accurately predict market crashes in advance

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is the first step toward overcoming cognitive bias in decision-making?
options: Becoming aware that the biases exist
Hiring more financial analysts
Avoiding all quick decisions permanently
Relying solely on computer algorithms for every decision

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.
